title: Godot 4.6.3 randomly cause BSOD on Windows (igdkmdn64.sys, SYSTEM_SERVICE_EXCEPTION) when opening a project
body:
### Tested versions

v4.6.3.stable.official [7d41c59c4]
The randomly BSOD problem also happens when I'm previously using v4.6.2-stable. 

### System information

Godot v4.6.3.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9597) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-1240P (16 threads) - 15.71 GiB memory

### Issue description

The Windows system randomly went BSOD when I attempted to open a project in Godot editor.

File: igdkmdn64.sys

Message: SYSTEM_SERVICE_EXCEPTION

1.Run the Godot editor executable.
2.Double-click a project to open it.
3.BSOD appears.
Looks like the problem happens most when I open the Godot editor **right after** I log on to Windows system.
